items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He had these people called Pablo Lights who did these light shows with oil lamps moving around projected on a screen.

ctx.x: The venue is still there, it’s in a different building; it’s still there, though. The thing about Bill Graham is he might have Muddy Waters with Jefferson Airplane… he would mix (it) up. He wouldn’t book one particular genre.
That was his gift! He was eclectic. He had these people called Pablo Lights who did these light shows with oil lamps moving around projected on a screen. It was just totally different.
